audience: Hungarian businesses and accountants who issue invoices and receipts with Számlázz.hu

useCases.title: Read an invoice or download its PDF
useCases.text: Reads an issued invoice by invoice number, order number or external id, with lines, totals, VAT breakdown and payments, or downloads its PDF.

useCases.title: Check whether a Hungarian company is a registered taxpayer
useCases.text: Looks up the first 8 digits of a tax number in the NAV register and shows if it is valid, the taxpayer's name, VAT status and addresses.

useCases.title: Issue an invoice
useCases.text: Issues a real invoice in Számlázz.hu. A final invoice is reported to NAV and can only be cancelled by a reversal.

useCases.title: Record payments on an invoice
useCases.text: Records 1 to 5 payments on an issued invoice or pro forma invoice, which updates its paid amount and outstanding balance.

useCases.title: Reverse an invoice or delete a pro forma invoice
useCases.text: Issues a reversal (storno) invoice that cancels an issued invoice, or deletes a pro forma invoice. A real invoice cannot be deleted.

useCases.title: Look up, issue, e-mail or reverse a receipt
useCases.text: Reads a receipt with its lines, payments and reversal status, issues a receipt, e-mails it to a customer, or reverses it.
